intended_use: Machine-consumable capability catalog for supported data-plane use cases and documented parameter permutations.

source.title: AWS Payment Cryptography Data Plane API Reference

interpretation_rules.use_case_definition: A use case is either an explicitly documented operation variant or a documented cartesian permutation of mutually exclusive request branches and enum values.
comprehensiveness_boundary: This catalog enumerates all documented operations in the data-plane API reference.
This catalog enumerates all documented union branches and all documented enum values that materially change behavior.
This catalog does not enumerate unbounded free-form values such as PANs, ciphertext, transaction data, KSNs, wrapped key blobs, or APDU payloads.
Where the documentation describes orthogonal dimensions instead of an explicit cartesian product, both the dimensions and any explicit compatibility rules are preserved.

fact_labels.documented: Directly stated in the API reference.
fact_labels.documented_with_internal_inconsistency: Present in the API reference but contradicted elsewhere in the same document.
fact_labels.inferred_from_structure: Derived from union structure or endpoint shape without an explicit prose statement for every combination.

cross_account_use.statement: Each listed operation in this catalog states that cross-account use is supported when the key has a resource-based policy that grants access.

notes: Dynamic keys are passed as TR-31 wrapped key blocks.
For symmetric data encryption operations, the key ARN refers to the key encryption key that protects the wrapped working key.

Member names differ by operation: WrappedKey (Encrypt/DecryptData), IncomingWrappedKey/OutgoingWrappedKey (ReEncryptData, TranslatePinData), EncryptionWrappedKey (GeneratePinData, VerifyPinData). GeneratePinData and VerifyPinData support postdates the 2026-05-14 PDF snapshot — found in the SDK service model 2026-07-06.

documentation_caveats.issue: The field description prose says AWS Payment Cryptography supports ISO_FORMAT_0 and ISO_FORMAT_3, but the valid-values list includes ISO_FORMAT_0, ISO_FORMAT_1, ISO_FORMAT_3, and ISO_FORMAT_4.
SymmetricEncryptionAttributes.PaddingType is documented with RSA-style values PKCS1, OAEP_SHA1, OAEP_SHA256, and OAEP_SHA512.

notes: If omitted, AWS Payment Cryptography defaults it to zero.
If omitted, AWS Payment Cryptography defaults it to zero.

compatibility_rules.rule: Formats that require PAN cannot be translated to a format that does not require PAN.
AWS Payment Cryptography currently supports ISO PIN block 4 translation for PIN block built using legacy PAN length, defined as the right-most 12 digits excluding the check digit.

operations.name: DecryptData
operations.purpose: Decrypt ciphertext to plaintext using symmetric, asymmetric, DUKPT, or EMV key schemes.

operations.name: EncryptData
operations.purpose: Encrypt plaintext to ciphertext using symmetric, asymmetric, DUKPT, or EMV key schemes.

operations.name: GenerateAs2805KekValidation
operations.purpose: Generate KEK validation request or response for AS2805 node-to-node initialization.

operations.name: GenerateAuthRequestCryptogram
operations.purpose: Generate an ARQC from an EMV application-cryptogram master key (E0) and transaction data — the inverse of VerifyAuthRequestCryptogram. In an issuer context this is primarily a test/reference generator (the chip generates production ARQCs).

notes: TDES E0 keys only: the operation rejects every AES E0 key (AES-128 and AES-256, under all session-key derivation modes) with an invalid-key-algorithm error. This is asymmetric with VerifyAuthRequestCryptogram, which requires AES-256 E0 for AES ARQC verification — net effect: APC cannot mint an AES ARQC. Verified live (us-east-1, 2026-07); not documented in the public API reference.
The E0 key must be created/imported with DeriveKey mode; NoRestrictions is rejected by this operation specifically.
TransactionData must arrive pre-padded (ISO 9797-1 method 2: append 0x80 then 0x00 to an 8-byte boundary), exactly as on the verify side.

PrimaryAccountNumber and PanSequenceNumber are required members INSIDE each SessionKeyDerivationAttributes union branch, not top-level fields (per the SDK service model). Amex and Visa branches take only PAN+PSN — no ApplicationTransactionCounter member exists for them; Emv2000/EmvCommon add required ATC; Mastercard adds required ATC and UnpredictableNumber.

source_reference.note: Operation postdates the API-reference PDF snapshot this catalog was generated from (2026-05-14); surfaced in AWS SDKs from ~1.110. Behavior verified against live APC (apc-hsm-proxy AES ARQC probe + apc-crossval).

operations.name: GenerateCardValidationData
operations.purpose: Generate card validation values such as CVV, CVV2, CSC, dCVV, or dCVC.

operations.name: GenerateMac
operations.purpose: Generate MAC cryptograms for direct algorithm, DUKPT, or EMV MAC schemes.

operations.name: GenerateMacEmvPinChange
operations.purpose: Generate issuer-script MAC and translated encrypted PIN block for EMV offline PIN change.

operations.name: GeneratePinData
operations.purpose: Generate PIN-related data such as PIN, PVV, PIN block, and PIN offset.

operations.name: ReEncryptData
operations.purpose: Re-encrypt ciphertext from one encryption context to another using symmetric or DUKPT key schemes.

operations.name: TranslateKeyMaterial
operations.purpose: Translate transaction key material from ECDH-wrapped TR-31 input to KEK-wrapped TR-31 output without importing the key.

operations.name: TranslatePinData
operations.purpose: Translate encrypted PIN blocks across ISO 9564 and AS2805 formats and across PEK, BDK/DUKPT, dynamic key, or ECDH protection contexts.

operations.name: VerifyAuthRequestCryptogram
operations.purpose: Verify ARQC and optionally generate ARPC using method 1 or method 2.

operations.name: VerifyCardValidationData
operations.purpose: Verify CVV, CVV2, CSC, dCVV, or dCVC.

operations.name: VerifyMac
operations.purpose: Verify MAC cryptograms for direct algorithm, DUKPT, or EMV MAC schemes.

operations.name: VerifyPinData
operations.purpose: Verify PIN-related data such as PIN and PIN offset using IBM3624 or Visa PIN verification flows.
